coverageBoundaryNote: Allowed ceiling locked to formal L001-L465 plus provisional 絕、活、該、應、答 and current 題: 475 unique Han.
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved L471 handoff. 題 ㄊㄧˊ. S01 應該 ㄧㄥ ㄍㄞ and 回答 ㄉㄚˊ; S02 答 ㄉㄚˊ; S05 答應 ㄉㄚ ㄧㄥˋ. 目 and 案 are forbidden learner-facing characters. S04 is a smoking broken car already stopped by police; generic driver is not father. S05 is a completely dead plant after several missed watering days.

sentences.text: 這個問題，我應該怎麼回答？
sentences.spokenText: 這個問題我應該怎麼回答
sentences.imageNotes: 家中書桌前，主角女孩指著作業本上的一道圖像算術題，轉頭詢問爸爸，表情疑惑。爸爸坐在旁邊，準備用桌上積木協助她理解。作業本以角度遮住文字，不要求生成可讀題目、算式或數字；重點是女孩不知道如何回答而求助。
sentences.imagePrompt: Square 1:1 modern children's picture-book illustration matching the approved L058 STYLE ONLY and refined L115/L118/L119/L128 examples: warm natural light, fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, softly layered gouache texture, detailed but clean Taiwan environment, stable preschool proportions, gentle expressive faces, bright warm palette, phone-readable composition and safe margins. Use recurring family identity anchors L154-S01, L162-S04 and L163-S02 whenever protagonist family appears. Protagonist girl: preschool age, short dark bob, small pink hairclip, pink cardigan, cream blouse, navy skirt and pink shoes. Fixed father: short dark hair, blue overshirt and cream shirt. Fixed mother: chin-length dark hair, cream cardigan and practical blue clothing. Teacher must be a distinct adult teacher in tidy classroom clothing and must not resemble the mother. Generic adults must not reuse the father or mother identity. Do not copy any L058 person. No readable text, letters, numbers, equations, labels, logos, watermarks, captions or speech bubbles. At the warm family study desk, the recurring protagonist girl points to a workbook angled away so no writing, equation or number is visible, then turns toward her fixed father with a puzzled asking expression. Father sits beside her and prepares simple blank wooden counting blocks to help her understand. The focus is asking how to answer, not already solving it.

sentences.text: 這個問題，你不該答不出來。
sentences.spokenText: 這個問題你不該答不出來
sentences.imageNotes: 教室裡，固定老師剛用紅、綠、白色卡帶孩子辨認顏色，接著指向紅色色卡詢問主角女孩，女孩卻遲疑。老師以「這個已經會了，再想一想」的提醒態度說話，不怒斥、不羞辱。桌上保留剛練習過的色卡，交代這不是突然問陌生內容；「你」指主角女孩。

sentences.text: 這本書的主題是動物的生活。
sentences.spokenText: 這本書的主題是動物的生活
sentences.imageNotes: 主角女孩和爸爸一起看一本攤開的圖畫書；書本是左右兩頁等寬、中央裝訂線清楚的正常對稱跨頁。左頁是鳥在巢裡餵小鳥；右頁分成小狗吃東西與小魚在水裡游動兩個完整圖區，所有圖區不跨越裝訂線。重點是動物如何生活，不生成可讀書名、段落或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt: Square 1:1 polished warm pencil-and-watercolor children’s illustration matching L058 style and recurring family anchors. Preserve the recurring protagonist girl and fixed father reading at home. The open book must be a physically correct symmetric two-page spread: left and right pages equal width, one centered binding crease, aligned corners and perspective. Left page contains only a parent bird feeding chicks. Right page contains two balanced text-free panels: puppy eating above and fish swimming below. No art crosses the gutter; no extra page; no readable text.

sentences.text: 車子有問題，絕對不能開上路。
sentences.spokenText: 車子有問題絕對不能開上路
sentences.imageNotes: 依老師指定，一位 generic 成年駕駛已被警察攔到路邊，故障車停妥，引擎蓋縫隙持續冒煙。警察指向冒煙的引擎，嚴肅告誡駕駛車有問題不能開上路；駕駛站在安全距離外，神情尷尬。畫面是已攔停後的告誡，不是正在追車。不得改回爸爸在家查看扁輪胎；不畫火焰、爆炸、傷者或孩子站在故障車旁，車牌及警察制服不放可讀字樣。

sentences.text: 做不到的事，不該答應別人。
sentences.spokenText: 做不到的事不該答應別人
sentences.imageNotes: 主角女孩答應替外出的朋友照顧盆栽，卻連續幾天沒澆水，植物已枯死。家中，媽媽指向盆栽，嚴肅又失望地提醒女孩；女孩低頭懊悔。盆中土壤乾裂，所有葉片乾褐萎縮、枝莖乾枯，沒有綠葉。澆水壺完整放在小桌左側的空地，與桌面、桌腳清楚分離，不穿透家具。依老師修復指示，媽媽上方有一個小型思考泡泡，呈現同一女孩每天替健康盆栽澆水的正確做法；泡泡與現場枯死植物清楚區隔，不放文字或數字。
sentences.imagePrompt: Square 1:1 polished warm pencil-and-watercolor children’s illustration matching L058 style and recurring mother/girl anchors. Present scene: mother points seriously at a completely dead plant with all-brown drooping leaves, brittle stems and cracked soil; remorseful girl looks down. Watering can rests fully on open floor left of the small table, with no overlap or penetration. Above mother is one small thought bubble showing the same girl watering a healthy potted plant as the daily routine she should have followed. Bubble and present scene are clearly separate. No text, numbers or extra people.
